verdict.rationale: Appwrite can run its entire backend on any OS with a Docker CLI. The official CLI accepts an --endpoint flag to target a self-hosted instance, and the Functions page advertises 'Develop locally, deploy when ready'. A community comment also notes the containerized setup makes development and testing easier. missing for 10: a dedicated lightweight emulator or explicit local-dev workflow documentation (the local path is the full self-hosted install), and hands-on corroboration of a local-to-cloud deploy workflow.
